Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset signs.webp for a side-view 2D game. The five attached images are style references only. Same hand-inked muted medieval cartoon artwork as the references: rough wobbly black ink outlines, flat muted colours, subtle paper grain, deadpan absurd humour about unemployment and job hunting. Sharp game art, clear silhouettes.
Create a single sprite sheet, EXACTLY 4 columns by 3 rows, total 1536 × 1152 pixels, cells 384 × 384. Twelve different isolated blank signs; ample transparent gutters, aligned bases at y=372 within each cell. Each complete object fits inside its cell with at least 14px transparent margin. True RGBA transparent background, no background paint, no checkerboard, no ground shadows, no grid or frame. Side view, each blank writing surface flat pale cream and FRONT FACING, no strong perspective, extremely generous room for game lettering. NO TEXT, no letters, numbers, logos or pictograms anywhere.
In reading order:
1 wooden direction pole with THREE blank arrows pointing left, right, right.
2 hanging blank rectangular wooden sign on its own gallows post.
3 large noticeboard on two posts holding three pinned blank parchment sheets.
4 triangular danger sign with red border and blank white centre on a crooked post.
5 circular prohibition sign with red border and blank white centre on a post.
6 blank wanted parchment nailed to a post.
7 stone milestone with blank pale face.
8 round-topped blank gravestone with a tiny grass tuft at the foot.
9 wooden grave cross with wide blank crossbar.
10 blank cardboard protest placard on a stick planted on the baseline.
11 small noticeboard on two posts with one blank torn-corner poster.
12 wooden A-frame pavement board, three-quarter frame but broad readable blank front face.
Preserve the cartoon ink character of the reference assets, not smooth vector graphics. No people. Do not put text into the asset.
